facts.fact: The Ministry of Industry announced on 2025-05-20 the launch of phase two of the E-kazi platform, letting entrepreneurs assemble online the company file to send to the one-stop shop (GUCE), with protocols with Justice and Finance still being finalised before full service.

COD.note: Startups are named only as users of the platform; no startup law or fund.
The tax number (NIF) is named as part of the company-creation journey, with the platform not yet in full service; no register is described.
No hub or park is described.
